item.title: Hezbollah says movement ‘proud of Iran ties,’ praises Islamic Republic’s backing for resistance
item.description: Hezbollah’s leader says Iran has “consistently stressed the importance of supporting the resistance,” adding that “the country, its Leader, and its people have stood alongside Hezbollah.”

item.title: Iran slams disarmament bodies for silence over attacks on its nuclear sites
item.description: Iran’s UN envoy in Vienna says the silence of disarmament bodies over attacks on Iranian nuclear sites undermines the purpose of the CTBT.

item.title: Araghchi: Israel’s chemical weapons claims aimed at dragging US into new war
item.description: Foreign Minister Araghchi says the Israeli regime's allegations about Iranian chemical weapons are to deceive Washington into waging another war on its behalf.

item.title: Iran tightens control over Strait of Hormuz with new systems: Army spokesman
item.description: The Iranian Army says the level of monitoring over the Strait of Hormuz has been upgraded through the introduction of new systems.

item.title: Tanker violating transit rules catches fire in Hormuz Strait: Iran’s Navy
item.description: The Navy said the incident involving the unidentified tanker occurred after it deactivated its navigation systems and entered a prohibited area east of the Strait.

item.title: Trump's war on Iran comes home to haunt Republicans
item.description: The 2026 U.S. midterm elections resulted in a sweeping Democratic victory, with voters rejecting Republicans largely because of the war against Iran which drove up gasoline prices amid broader inflation.

item.title: Persian translation of al-Baladhuri’s landmark historical work unveiled at University of Tehran
item.description: The 13-volume translation brings a major source on early Islamic history, Arab-Iranian cultural ties and Iran's historical heritage to Persian-speaking readers.

item.title: Iran thrash Saudi Arabia to book semi-final berth at AFC Beach Soccer Asian Cup 2026
item.description: Iran maintain their title defence in dominant fashion, extending their winning run to four matches as they close in on a fifth continental crown.

item.title: Iran's military might, readiness at new high, enemy already feels defeat: IRGC chief
item.description: The IRGC commander says Iran's enemies are facing one of their most critical periods despite their extensive efforts to undermine the nation's resolve.

item.title: Trump says war on Iran funded only through January, claims ‘regime change’ not his goal
item.description: Trump says the US war against Iran is funded only through January, claiming that ‘regime change’ was never his goal.

item.title: Two oil tankers catch fire after hitting naval mines in Strait of Hormuz: IRGC
item.description: The IRGC Navy warns vessels against covert passage and sailing with their navigation systems switched off in the Strait of Hormuz, saying they could face the danger of naval mine explosions.

item.title: Iran warns against weaponization of AI, demands accountability and reparations for US aggression
item.description: Darzi says technology must serve humanity and be used exclusively for peaceful purposes, not aggression, domination or violations of state sovereignty.

item.title: More than 200 migrants evacuated from makeshift camp beneath Paris metro
item.description: More than 200 migrants evacuated beneath a Paris metro face a return to the streets as temporary shelter runs out.

item.title: Survivors rescued after Pakistan building collapse kills at least 3
item.description: Emergency responders rescue several survivors from the rubble after a multi-storey building under construction collapsed in Karachi.

item.title: Thousands in Greece strike over wages, public services
item.description: The action, called by Greece’s largest public sector trade union, ADEDY, sought the restoration of annual bonuses scrapped during the debt crisis.
